title: A batch whose administrative call (add an owner, threshold unchanged) is named, sourced to a ticket and given a rollback (clean control)

proof.python:
import json
tx = json.load(open('plan.json'))['txs']
book = {e['name']: e['address'] for e in json.load(open('address_book.json'))['entries']}
assert tx[0]['data'][2:10] == '0d582f13' and tx[0]['args']['owner'] == book['owner-carol'] and int(tx[0]['data'][-64:], 16) == 3
assert json.load(open('safe_state.json'))['threshold'] == 3 and all(t['operation'] == 0 for t in tx)
